title: pipeline-failure: agent phase down 2 consecutive runs (as of 2026-09-18T06:16Z-local)
body:
The Phase B curation agent has failed two runs in a row (latest exit code 1). Candidates are piling up untriaged (they will not expire while the agent is down, but discovery is stalled).

Check the latest logs/run-*.log. If the error is a 401/expired token, run any interactive claude command on the host to refresh credentials.
